newsitem.title: USA: U.S. domestic grades gain led by Louisiana buying.
newsitem.headline: U.S. domestic grades gain led by Louisiana buying.

text.p: U.S. crude grades advanced Wednesday for both sweet and sour barrels, supported by a drive to buy grades and avoid West Texas Intermediate/Cushing supplies ahead of May pipeline scheduling.
Traders said the abundance of WTI/Cushing, and talk of Nigerian Bonny Light and North Sea Brent delveries to Cushing against the May NYMEX contract, have put the outright cash market on edge.
May/June WTI spreads stayed surprisingly quiet all session, moving only in five cent increments from even marks. Traders said June/July contango was indicative of bearishness.
